hotspot_guide_gemini_key_budgets_usd.label: Monthly budget per Gemini key (USD)
hotspot_guide_gemini_key_budgets_usd.help: Optional. Configure and save per slot (A, B, C, D...) directly in the Gemini key pool above; 0 or blank means no budget. What actually switches keys is Google refusing: 402 once a prepaid balance runs out, or 429 at a monthly spending cap.

hotspot_guide_gemini_api_keys_extra.label: Extra Gemini keys (Google AI Ultra accounts)
hotspot_guide_gemini_api_keys_extra.help: Enter and save keys individually per slot (A, B, C, D...) in the Gemini key pool above. Slots rotate circularly (A -> B -> C -> ... -> A) as each Ultra account's credit is used up; the site key only takes over once all Ultra slots are exhausted.

panel.title: Gemini key pool (Google AI Ultra slots)
panel.intro: Enter and save each Google AI Ultra key in its own slot (A, B, C, D...) and add more slots anytime. When the active slot runs out of credit or hits its cap, the pool advances to the next slot (A -> B -> C -> ... and wraps back to A). You can also pick which slot to start from.
panel.error: Could not read the key pool
panel.single: There is only one Gemini key. Save Ultra account keys in slots A, B, C... below to enable circular rotation.
panel.keyPlaceholder: Enter Gemini API key for this slot
